summary: Avidbank Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of $30 million of 7.00% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036, sold at par to institutional accredited investors. Proceeds will redeem/repurchase its $22 million 5.000% subordinated notes due 2029 and for general purposes. The notes mature September 1, 2036, are non-convertible, and redeemable by the company after September 1, 2031. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation, so the filing is classified as None.
